_about: Settings for Vancouver's Routes page (engine/routes/: build.py, page.html), at /vancouver/routes/: pick a stop or SkyTrain platform near you, see where each TransLink bus and SkyTrain line from it goes. SkyTrain comes from raw/surface/rapid_*.json (surface.json 'rapid', found by name with 'rapidMatch'), its platforms in order; West Coast Express stations count as connections too. TransLink's real-time feed needs a developer key and its own terms, so the page shows scheduled departures.

page.title: Where does this line or route go?
page.description: Find the TransLink bus stops and SkyTrain platforms nearest you in Vancouver and see where each route goes, with the next scheduled departures: the local areas it passes through, the main streets it runs along, its SkyTrain and West Coast Express connections and the landmarks on the way.
page.lede: Find the stops and stations near you, then pick a bus or SkyTrain line to see where it goes: the local areas, main streets, connections and landmarks along the way.
page.outside: That spot is outside Vancouver. Try an address in the city or the UEL.
page.noMatch: No match in Vancouver for “{q}”. Try the full street address, like “453 W 12th Ave”.
page.noStops: No stops or stations within {r} of that spot.
page.credits: Routes, stops and timetable: TransLink GTFS · Local areas: City of Vancouver Open Data · Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Times are scheduled; TransLink’s real-time feed needs a key
page.connectWith: SkyTrain and the West Coast Express
page.legendKnown: Commercial Drive: the names people use
page.connectionsLabel: SkyTrain and West Coast Express connections

badges._about: Route badge colours for apps (the web page takes them from factsheet.css): buses dark blue, RapidBus green, NightBus white with a navy outline; SkyTrain lines as plain dots in the line's colour.

_nameRules: OpenStreetMap writes Vancouver's streets in full (West 4th Avenue, East Hastings Street); the page writes them as the street signs do (W 4th Ave, E Hastings St).
_overground: page 'overground': SkyTrain runs mostly on elevated guideway, so it 'runs along' its streets (the downtown and Canada Line tunnels are the exception).
